title: 8.38. Cittasaṁsaṭṭhaduka

verses.t: Nacittasaṁsaṭṭhaṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca nacittasaṁsaṭṭho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā … (Saṅkhittaṁ.)
